notes.title: The Syndicate Navy DLC + 2 Extra Navies are now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33566314/e21f6b5ca0866ed0ba531a7246669ed9fa9e2ec8.jpg[/img]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809790/Final_Theory_Syndicate_Navy][b]Syndicate Navy[/b][/url] DLC is now available, alongside two additional DLC navies. The ships of the Syndicate Navy feature a mix of new abilities and weapons, titanium alloy armor plating, advanced shields, long range railguns, energy weapons and much more. The package includes a full navy consisting of 8 ships in total: Dreadnought, Battleship, Carrier, Battlecruiser, Cruiser, Destroyer, Frigate and Corvette.

The Syndicate Navy DLC features

[list][*] 7 different ship classes to command + 1 deployable ship.
[*] 7 fleet-wide stackable ship bonuses.
[*] 8 ship tiers featuring weapons, abilities and skill points.
[*] 56 module upgrades to choose from.
[*] Supports the main game, Quick Battles and Custom Battles right out of the box.
You don't have to unlock any achievements before you can use the navy.[/list]

[h2]Introducing Legendary Navies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33566314/13b62a334b9809be8b2d34cf7a8c807810d4da04.jpg[/img]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809800/Final_Theory_Colonial_Navy][b]Colonial Navy[/b][/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809810/Final_Theory_Federal_Navy][b]Federal Navy[/b][/url] are both variants of existing navies that hold special historical significance in the world of Final Theory. They feature an alternative weapons and abilities loadout from their base navies, while also retaining a measure of familiarity. These two new navies are now available as part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24264/Final_Theory__Legendary_Bundle][b]Legendary Bundle[/b][/url], and can be collected and used to add variety to your games.


[h2]New Bundles Now Available[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33566314/e60bc6e88675d35fc7fff1186ffb8331edf9b572.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Deluxe Bundle includes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Final Theory Game
(Includes the Imperial Navy)
[*] The Royal Navy DLC
[*] The Syndicate Navy DLC
[/list]
[h3]The Legendary Bundle includes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Final Theory Game
(Includes the Imperial Navy)
[*] The Royal Navy DLC
[*] The Syndicate Navy DLC
[*] The Colonial Navy DLC
[*] The Federal Navy DLC
[/list]
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24262/Final_Theory__Deluxe_Bundle][b]Deluxe Bundle[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24264/Final_Theory__Legendary_Bundle][b]Legendary Bundle[/b][/url] are both adaptive bundles. Adaptive means you'll only be paying for and getting, the content that you don't already have, and you still get the bundle discount.

Buying a bundle will however not include DLC that is added to the bundles in the future. But as adaptive bundles, they can be repurchased to just pick up future DLC, and you will still be getting the bundle discount that is active at that point in time.

In short, adaptive bundles are awesome and will always hold the biggest savings.

Head on over to the Steam pages to get a better look at the new navies:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809790/Final_Theory_Syndicate_Navy][b]Syndicate Navy[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809800/Final_Theory_Colonial_Navy][b]Colonial Navy[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809810/Final_Theory_Federal_Navy][b]Federal Navy[/b][/url]

As always a huge thanks to all of our players. It's fantastic to see so many new players having a go at Final Theory, as well as our veteran players eagerly awaiting the new content. We hope all of you will welcome the new navies and have fun playing with them. Stay tuned for even more content on the horizon and we thank all of you for your support.

-Monticube

notes.title: The Syndicate Navy DLC + 2 Extra Navies, Coming January 2022
notes.content:
The release of the new DLC navies will be pushed back to [strike]early[/strike] January 2022.

Unfortunately 2021 wasn't quite done throwing curveballs and we ran into a few unexpected real life problems. This has left us with the option of either doing a frantic release during the Steam Winter Sale, or move the release to [strike]early[/strike] January 2022. As many of you know, while it is possible to release on Steam during a major sales event, it would limit release day exposure quite dramatically since there are so many great deals to be had, and as a small indie title we unfortunately can't endure such a loss. While we do apologize for the delay, we also have high hopes for an amazing 2022 with still more exciting news to come. It's awesome to see so many of you showing an interest in all of the upcoming navies and we're very excited to bring you guys and gals this new content come January.

A quick shout out and a huge thanks to Matt from SplatterCatGaming for featuring Final Theory on his YouTube channel. We would like to take this opportunity to welcome all of the new and returning players to the community. If you haven't already please pop by his channel and hit that Subscribe button.

We wish all of our players, their friends and families a happy new year, and we thank all of you for your amazing support. Stay safe everyone.

-Monticube

notes.title: Royal Navy DLC now available + Patch 1.4 of Final Theory
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33566314/9b843c44f164d69476a3d7e2d04d4eb6cbacec5b.jpg[/img]
The Royal Navy DLC is now available, along with patch 1.4 of Final Theory.

[b]Final Theory - Patch 1.4[/b]
[list]
[*] New map ability: Propaganda Campaign
Broadcast propaganda to convince neutral or enemy regions to join your fight against the Empire. Take advantage of failed attempts that can lead to incursion opportunities deep behind enemy lines.
[*] The core Imperial regions will now be guarded by the Royal Navy.
(This final battle event is available to all players.)
[*] Lower difficulties reworked to allow for a more casual experience.
[*] Game engine updated.
[*] Quality of life improvements and more.
[/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/894630/discussions/0/4576185279368583637/]See Full Patch Notes[/url]


[b]The Royal Navy DLC[/b]

The ships of the Royal Navy feature a mix of new abilities and weapons, gold alloy armor plating, particle beams, cluster bombs, long range missiles and more.
[list]
[*] 7 different ship classes to command + 1 deployable ship.
[*] 7 fleet-wide stackable ship bonuses.
[*] 8 ship tiers featuring weapons, abilities and skill points.
[*] 56 module upgrades to choose from.
[*] Play as, or against the Royal Navy.
[*] Supports the main game, Quick Battles and Custom Battles right out of the box.
(You don't have to unlock any achievements before you can use the navy.)
[*] Quick Battles and Custom Battles support PvP through Steam Remote Play Together.
[/list]
This release is the first DLC navy for Final Theory with still more to come. As always a huge thanks to all of our players. Your support and enthusiasm is what has allowed the continued development of the game. This navy has been a long time coming, and we know a lot of you have been waiting patiently for it's release. We're so delighted to say, the wait is over and it's time to take the Royal Navy for a spin.

Happy holidays, stay safe everyone and we thank all of you for your support.

-Monticube

notes.title: Patch 1.3 Celebration Discount - Quick and Custom Battles with PvP
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33566314/e8d297b61ed0c7efc0151bbbcabf0e017cfb04f3.png[/img]
With the release of Patch 1.3 and with summer just around the corner, we wanted to add a celebration discount to the game. Now you can pick up the game at an amazing price, or gift it to a friend so they can practice their battle skills.

Jump straight into the action with the new Quick Battles, or setup a Custom Battle with the exact ships, upgrades and adjustments you want to use. Deploy up to 15 ships each and battle against your friends by inviting them to join your game. Simply launch the game, click on a friend from your friends list and select Remote Play Together.

Learn more about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Steam Remote Play Together[/url]

[list]
[*] New game modes: Quick and Custom Battles.
[*] More player colors added.
[*] Achievements window added.
[*] AI updated and more.
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/894630/discussions/0/2283834583168329121/]See Full Patch Notes[/url]


Stay safe and have fun challenging your friends.

-Monticube
